subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should this issue be narrowed to non-destructive selected-message branching, with destructive moves and multi-session composer fanout excluded or tracked separately?
rationale: Current main already supplies session groups, management controls, full-session forks, checkpoint branches, worktrees, and split panes; the remaining behavior introduces compatibility-sensitive transcript and delivery contracts that source inspection cannot choose.

options.title: Narrow to selected branch
options.body: Add branch-at-message behavior through the existing session model and leave destructive move and fanout outside this issue.

options.title: Design full triage system
options.body: Include destructive transcript moves and atomic multi-session sends with explicit undo, retry, and partial-failure behavior.

options.title: Accept existing workflows
options.body: Use groups, forks, checkpoint branches, worktrees, and panes without adding message-level branching.

recommendation.title: Narrow to selected branch
recommendation.body: Add branch-at-message behavior through the existing session model and leave destructive move and fanout outside this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged thread-management implementation and prior issue routing provide the strongest current product and implementation context.
